### Finding God in Creation (Romans 1:19-20)
Author: Betsy St. Amant Haddox
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-november-18.html
Passage: Romans 1:19-20
Points:
- The beauty, order, and changing seasons of the earth bear constant witness to God's glory and reality.
- Natural patterns display spiritual truths, from the promise of resurrection in spring foliage to God's constancy in sunrise and sunset.
- God not only established the physical universe, but actively watches over and cares for all living creatures.
- Because God has displayed His invisible attributes so clearly throughout creation, no one has an excuse for denying Him.

### The Primal Sin of Humanity
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/primal-sin-humanity
Passage: Romans 1:19–21
Points:
- The root reason people reject God is moral rebellion and hostility toward Him rather than an intellectual lack of evidence.
- Creation reveals God's eternal power, wise providence, and gracious goodness clearly to all humanity.
- Humanity's foundational sin is refusing to honor and thank the Creator despite possessing clear knowledge of Him.
- Suppressing the truth twists human reasoning into futility, producing spiritual darkness that only the gospel and Holy Spirit can dispel.
